Synopsis:
Naaber's dialog at Carmen's Cosmetics Shop in Wyrm's Crossing. He's very annoying and going through his entire dialog will give you an experience reward.

Cluster Contexts:
- LOW_Figaros_Naaber.json: The scene takes place inside Carmen’s Cosmetics shop in Wyrm’s Crossing, where the player encounters Naaber, an overly chatty, attention‑seeking NPC. He pesters the player with silly performances and self‑promotional questions (singing “happy birthday,” shouting “put ’em up,” asking whether he could be a bard or fighter) and generally won’t stop until you cut him off. You can brusquely rebuff him or let him run through his whole spiel — doing so yields a small experience reward. This is an ambient Lower City encounter during the Act II intermezzo; larger city events (brainquakes, Orin/Gortash tensions) may be happening off‑screen but don’t change his behavior.
- LOW_Figaros_Naaber_AD.json: Repeated AD for Naaber when he is following you at Carmen's cosmetics shop or the Chiontar riverside in Wyrm's Crossing.
- WYR_FigaroSister_Carmen.json: Default dialogue with Carmen Pennygood, owner of a cosmetics shop in Wyrm's Crossing near Wyrm's Rock. Sister of Figaro "Facemaker" Pennygood, owner of a rival cosmetics shop in Baldur's Gate. They have a strained relationship.
- LOW_Elfsong_Cat_001_SwA.json: Dialog with Cat_001, Tambourine, at Elfsong Tavern cellar. Near the rats. The cat is a lazy one that doesn't want to hunt the rats.
- LOW_SerialKiller_Flaerith.json: Dialogue with the half-elf wine merchant Flaerith, at the Wine Festival in the front door of Highberry's House.

Dialogue Excerpts (up to 3 samples, ordered):
Sample 1:
- Naaber: Happy birthday to you, happy birthday to you, happy biiiiiiirthday dear... (node 54)
- Player: It's not my birthday. (node 210)
- Naaber: It isn't? Shoot. What did you think, anyway? (node 61)
- Naaber: Could I be a good bard? (node 91)
- Naaber: What do you think? Am I a good bard? (node 53)
- Player: Never sing again. (node 73)

Sample 2:
- Naaber: Put 'em up put 'em up! (node 146)
- Player: Put what up? (node 112)
- Naaber: Your fists, silly! I'm trying something out. (node 262)
- Naaber: My name's Naaber, adventurer-to-be, soon to be the best adventurer anyone's ever seen. (node 139)
- Naaber: As soon as I figure out what kind of adventurer I'm going to be... What do you think? Could I be a fighter? (node 60)
- Player: Here's a tip to get you started - less talking, more fighting. (node 46)

Sample 3:
- Naaber: Put 'em up put 'em up! (node 146)
- Player: What do you want? (node 1)
- Naaber: Yay! You spoke to me! Nobody ever talks to me. (node 6)
- Naaber: My name's Naaber, adventurer-to-be, soon to be the best adventurer anyone's ever seen. (node 139)

context: The scene takes place inside Carmen Pennygood’s cosmetics shop in Wyrm’s Crossing, where the player meets Naaber, an overly chatty, attention‑seeking NPC who pesters passersby with silly performances and self‑promotional questions. He’ll sing “happy birthday,” shout “put ’em up,” and ask whether he could be a bard or a fighter, and he generally won’t stop until you cut him off. This is an ambient Lower City encounter during the Act II intermezzo (larger city events may be happening off‑screen but don’t affect him), and there’s a repeated variant where Naaber follows you around the shop or the Chiontar riverside. You can brusquely rebuff him or let him run through his whole spiel — the latter awards a small experience reward.
